name: Is it better to patch a small drywall hole myself or hire someone?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to patch a small drywall hole myself or hire someone?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIY is worth comparing against professional repair when you care about speed, texture matching, or a clean paint-ready finish. If you only have one tiny hole, DIY may save money; if you have multiple spots or a wall that’s highly visible, hiring a pro usually saves frustration.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY makes sense for tiny cosmetic fixes. For visible walls, texture matching, or several repairs, hiring a pro usually gives a cleaner result with less hassle.
